title: fix(objectql): the 503 text for a failed datasource no longer blames a startup connect under OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoXFoG5pmoNTrXPd7hYMN4JA)_

Fixes #28135

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据源连接失败时的 503(`ERR_DATASOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`)提示不再一律说「启动时连接失败、且以 OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE 启动、必须重启」,改为「最近一次连接失败」并指向 Setup → Datasources 或服务器日志;只有该开关确实开着时,才附带一句有条件的「代码声明的数据源需重启」。
- 为什么改:运行中安装的包(install-local)和在 Setup 里新建的数据源连接失败时,用户被告知去重启一台从未带该开关启动的服务器,原因也是错的;连接层对所有来源记录的都是同一个 `failed`,所以文案不再声称它不知道的来源。
- 风险与回滚:只改错误文案与文档,错误码、503 状态、`reason: failed` 均不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/driver-connect-errors.ts`(`failed` 分支与 `degradedBootNote`)、`packages/objectql/src/datasource-unavailable.test.ts`(开关开/关两条 pin)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/datasource-unavailable.test.ts`,预期 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`DatasourceUnavailableError`'s `failed` arm said every such datasource "failed to connect at startup and the server was started with `OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE` … must be restarted". The connection layer cannot back that claim: it records every failed connect as the same `{ kind: 'failed' }`.

| # | Origin | Caller → service | Trigger | Flag needed to reach a running server | Engine record | What re-runs the connect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Boot, code-declared, bound / mapped / bootCritical / `onMismatch: 'fail'` | `AppPlugin.start` → `connectPackageDatasources(installed: false)` → `connectDeclared`; `DefaultDatasourcePlugin` → `connect` | `declared-auto` | yes (otherwise the boot is refused) | `{ kind: 'failed' }` | restart |
| 2 | Boot, code-declared, `autoConnect: true`, nothing bound | same | `declared-auto` | no (degrades with a warning) | `{ kind: 'failed' }` | restart |
| 3 | install-local, hot install | `MarketplaceInstallLocal` → `connectPackageDatasources(installed: true)` | `declared-auto` | no (the fatal throw is caught, verdict returned) | `{ kind: 'failed' }` | reinstall, restart |
| 4 | install-local, rehydrate at boot | same | `declared-auto` | no | `{ kind: 'failed' }` | restart |
| 5 | Setup create / update | `registerPool` → `connect`, `reregisterPool` → `reconnect` | `runtime-admin` | no (never fatal) | `{ kind: 'failed' }` | save in Setup, restart |
| – | Policy refusal, any origin | any | any | – | `{ kind: 'blocked', publicDetail? }` | – |

`DatasourceConnectionService.recordState` maps availability to the kind and drops trigger, origin and flag; `publicDetail` is set only by a policy denial (measured on `main` 69c39b16).

So the `failed` arm now names no origin: "its last connect attempt failed, so no driver serves it", ending "See Setup → Datasources or the server log for the cause." The one fact that can make a restart sentence true is the process flag: without `OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE` origin 1 cannot exist, because that boot is refused. While the flag is set, the message adds, conditionally, that a datasource declared in code whose connect failed at startup is re-connected only by a restart. The flag is read through `resolveAllowDriverConnectFailure` from `@objectstack/types`, the same parse the boot paths use; it reads `process` through `globalThis` and answers `false` without one, so the constructor cannot throw.

Unchanged: the `blocked` and `remote` arms, the code, the 503, the `reason` class, `publicDetail`, the "See … for the cause" tail, and the rule that the message never carries the underlying cause.

Also re-worded, because they quoted the old sentence: `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx` (the 503 section), `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` (what a query against an unusable datasource says), and the restated error in two `plugin-security` fixtures (`controlled-by-parent-sharing.test.ts`, `store-fault-fail-closed.test.ts`). Patch changeset `.changeset/28135-datasource-unavailable-failed-cause.md`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/datasource-unavailable.test.ts`: the old degraded-boot pin is split in two. With the flag set (the boot-under-flag origin) the message says the connect failed and, conditionally, that a restart re-runs it. With the flag unset (the install-local and Setup origins, which record the same kind) it names neither the flag, a restart nor "at startup", and ends with the new tail. The "never carries the underlying cause" pin now asserts `Setup → Datasources` instead of `startup logs`.
- Ablation, on committed head ea7bffd6, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `if (!resolveAllowDriverConnectFailure()) return '';`, 1 → 0 hits each leg):
  - guard replaced by `if (false) return '';` (note always said): the flag-unset pin goes red (1 failed);
  - guard replaced by `return '';` (note never said): the flag-set pin goes red (1 failed);
  - restored: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob 82ec394a equals `HEAD:packages/objectql/src/driver-connect-errors.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Follow-up for the seat to decide (not filed):** the engine cannot tell the five origins apart. Naming the recorded origin needs `IDataEngine.markDatasourceUnavailable`'s info shape widened in `packages/spec` (its literal union is pinned by `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.test.ts`), and `DatasourceUnavailableKind` is served as the 503's wire `reason`, so a new kind member is not an option either. Two docblocks state the old narrow meaning of `failed` and belong to that follow-up: `IDataEngine.markDatasourceUnavailable` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` ("the connect failed while the operator opted into a degraded boot") and `ObjectQL.markDatasourceUnavailable` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`. Two code comments also describe `failed` that way and were left alone as outside this card's file surface: `packages/objectql/src/engine-datasource-routing.ts` (above the unavailable lookup) and `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts` (above the 503 mapping pin).
- The degraded-boot banner printed by `DatasourceConnectionService.handleFailure` says "DEGRADED BOOT" also for a package install into a running server while the flag is set (origin 3 under the flag). Not touched here; noted only.
- `packages/objectql/src/datasource-mapping.test.ts` keeps its comment calling its `failed` mark "a failed boot connect under OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE"; that is still one true origin of the record.
